title: Normal-space transfer: I − Q′ maps T^⊥ onto T′^⊥ with inverse norm ≤ 2 when ‖Q′ − Q‖ ≤ 1/2
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let T, T′ be linear subspaces of ℝ^P with dim T = dim T′. Let Q, Q′ be the orthogonal projections of ℝ^P onto T and T′, and assume ‖Q′ − Q‖ ≤ 1/2 (operator norm). Then for every n ∈ T′^⊥ there is e ∈ T^⊥ with e − Q′e = n and |e| ≤ 2|n|.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (T T' : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ T = Module.finrank ℝ T' → ‖T'.starProjection - T.starProjection‖ ≤ 1 / 2 → ∀ n ∈ T'ᗮ, ∃ e ∈ Tᗮ, e - T'.starProjection e = n ∧ ‖e‖ ≤ 2 * ‖n‖
